dialogue.content: 相談者です。本日は宜しくお願い致します！
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します！
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to speak with you, too.

dialogue.content: それではお悩み内容、性別、年齢を教えてもらえますか？！
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me about your concerns, your gender, and your age?

dialogue.content: いつも人の顔色を見て生活してしまう言葉にに疲れています。
dialogue.English: I'm tired of always living my life reading people's moods.

dialogue.content: 35歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 35-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: すいません、言葉ではなく事です
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I meant the act of it, not the word.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。周りの事を考え過ぎてしまうのですね。。それはお辛いですね。。因みになんとお呼びしたら良いでしょうか？！
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel you're overly concerned about what others think. That must be very difficult. By the way, how should I address you?

dialogue.content: かおりです
dialogue.English: Kaori.

dialogue.content: かおりさんですね。そのお悩みはいつ頃からですか？また、けっかけはありますか？
dialogue.English: Kaori, I see. When did this concern begin? And was there a particular trigger for it?

dialogue.content: きっかけはよくわかりませんが、子供の頃からそんな感じですね
dialogue.English: I'm not sure about a specific trigger, but I've been like this since I was a child.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。かおりさんの視野が広い分、周りにも気になってしまうのですね。。今は特にどんな時に1番お辛い気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Perhaps because you are so perceptive, you're more aware of those around you. Currently, in what situations do you find it most distressing?

dialogue.content: 辛いというか、疲れてしまいます
dialogue.English: It's less that it's distressing and more that it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: 人と接するととても疲れます
dialogue.English: Interacting with people is very tiring.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。気を遣ってしまうのですね。お仕事は何をされているのですか？！
dialogue.English: I see. You feel you have to be very careful around others. What do you do for work?

dialogue.content: 介護職をしています
dialogue.English: I'm a caregiver.

dialogue.content: 素敵なお仕事ですね。いつからやられているのですか？
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful job. How long have you been doing it?

dialogue.content: 5年前ぐらいですね
dialogue.English: For about five years.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。お仕事では、やりがいと、大変な気持ちはどちらが強いですか？
dialogue.English: I see. In your work, which feels stronger—the sense of fulfillment or the difficulty?

dialogue.content: 仕事はやりがいがあります。介護自体、大好きです
dialogue.English: My work is rewarding. I really love caregiving itself.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。すごく素敵な事ですね！人間関係で疲れてしまう時は、仕事中ですか、それともプライベートですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That's really wonderful. When you feel exhausted by relationships, does it happen more at work, or in your personal life?

dialogue.content: 顔色を見てしまうのは、職場でも家庭でもありますね
dialogue.English: I end up reading people's moods both at work and at home.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。どちらからも疲れを感じてしまう事はお辛いですね、、、因みに、、
dialogue.English: I see. It must be tough feeling drained in both settings... By the way...

dialogue.content: リラックス出来る瞬間などはありますか？
dialogue.English: Are there any moments when you're able to relax?

dialogue.content: 瞬間というか、時間はありますか？
dialogue.English: Or rather than moments, do you have time to relax?

dialogue.content: リラックスというか、楽なのは1人でいる時なのかなとは思います
dialogue.English: Rather than relaxing, I think I feel most at ease when I'm alone.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。私も1人の時間は凄くリラックス出来ます。ご自宅ではどなたと暮らされているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I also find alone time very relaxing. Who do you live with at home?

dialogue.content: 夫、子供2人、義両親で住んでいます
dialogue.English: I live with my husband, two children, and my parents-in-law.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。因みに今のお悩みを相談出来る方は周りにいらっしゃいますか？！
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, is there anyone around you who you can talk to about these concerns?

dialogue.content: いないですね
dialogue.English: No, there isn't.

dialogue.content: 普段あまり自分の事は、話したいと思えません
dialogue.English: I usually don't feel like talking about myself.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね・・それはお辛いですね・・家では一人でいる時間は確保できていますか？
dialogue.English: I see... That must be difficult. Are you able to find any time to be alone at home?

dialogue.content: なかなかの大人数なので、1人になれる時間はほぼないです
dialogue.English: It's quite a large household, so I have almost no time to be alone.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・家でも職場でも中々一人でいる時間はないのですね？あまり人と関わらない他の仕事をしたいお気持ちはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... So you hardly have any time to yourself either at home or at work? Do you ever feel like you'd want a different job that involves less interaction with people?

dialogue.content: 介護の仕事の時、お年寄りとお話するのは楽しいので、辞めたいとは思いませんね
dialogue.English: When I'm working in caregiving, I enjoy talking with the elderly, so I don't feel like quitting.

dialogue.content: やりがいがあります
dialogue.English: It's rewarding.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。それではお仕事をしている時が一番良い状態のような感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So does it feel like you're at your best when you're working?

dialogue.content: お年寄りと関わっている時は、楽しいので、その時は顔色は見ないと思います
dialogue.English: When I'm interacting with the elderly, I enjoy it, so I don't think I'm reading their moods then.

dialogue.content: 素敵な心をおもちなのですね。色々聞かせて頂いた結果、家庭での生活のほうが疲れてしまうような感覚ですか？
dialogue.English: You have such a kind heart. From what you've shared, does it feel like life at home is more exhausting?

dialogue.content: 職場ではスタッフ仲間の顔色を見ていますし、家では夫や義両親の顔色を見てしまいます
dialogue.English: At work, I read my colleagues' moods, and at home, I end up reading my husband's and parents-in-law's moods.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。言いづらい事を打ち明けていただきありがとうございます。旦那さまとは昔からそのような関係性なのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing something that must be difficult to talk about. Have you always had that kind of dynamic with your husband?

dialogue.content: 夫というか…みんなに対してそうなので…
dialogue.English: It's not just my husband... I'm like that with everyone.

dialogue.content: 夫との関係が悪い、とかでは特にないです
dialogue.English: It's not that my relationship with my husband is bad or anything.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。因みにどうして普段自分の事をあまり話したくないお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, why is it that you usually don't feel like talking about yourself?

dialogue.content: どうしてでしょうかね…本音を言いたくないとか、見せたくないのかもしれません
dialogue.English: I wonder why... Maybe I don't want to say what I truly feel, or I don't want to show it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。本音を話して傷ついたご経験などはあったりするのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you had any experiences where you were hurt after sharing your true feelings?

dialogue.content: うーん、今あまりパッとは浮かばないですが、いつからか、そうなっていました
dialogue.English: Hmm, nothing comes to mind right away, but at some point, it just became that way.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。因みに周りの方はかおりさんに対してお悩みを相談したりすることはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, do people around you ever come to you for advice about their problems?

dialogue.content: はい、友達や職場の人達は、よく色々相談してきますね
dialogue.English: Yes, my friends and coworkers often consult me about various things.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。相談された時、かおりさんはどのようにかんじますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When they consult you, how does that make you feel?

dialogue.content: 何か答えてあげないと！と真剣に考えます、一緒に
dialogue.English: I feel like I have to give them an answer! So I think about it very seriously, along with them.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。お優しいお気持ちがあるのですね。相談の後、感謝される事は多いですか？
dialogue.English: I see... You have a very kind heart. Are you often thanked after giving advice?

dialogue.content: そうですね、それはありますが、でももう何でも相談されてくると疲れます
dialogue.English: Yes, that happens, but I get tired when people come to me with every little problem.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね・・その疲れてしまう原因というのは、もう少し自分で考えてほしいというお気持ちからですか？
dialogue.English: I see... Is the reason you get tired because you wish they would think about it a little more themselves?

dialogue.content: 私が真剣に考えている時間が、単純に疲れてしまう感じがします
dialogue.English: I think the time I spend thinking so seriously is what's simply exhausting.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと答えてあげなきゃ！と強く思うので
dialogue.English: Because I feel so strongly that I have to give them a proper answer.

dialogue.content: でも、相手も相当悩んでいるでしょうから、自分で考えて欲しいとは思わないですね
dialogue.English: But I know they must be very worried too, so I don't wish they would just think for themselves.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。すごくかおりさんのお優しい気持ちを感じますね。ですが、真剣に考えたら疲れてしまう。それは自然なことだと思います。家ではどのような場面でつかれますか？
dialogue.English: I see. I can really feel your kindness, Kaori. But it's natural to feel tired after thinking about something so seriously. At home, in what situations do you get tired?

dialogue.content: 義両親の顔色も見ているので、自分の行動全てにおいて、これで大丈夫かな？と気になります
dialogue.English: I'm also watching my parents-in-law's expressions, so with everything I do, I worry, "Is this okay?"

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。自分の直感で行動した際に何か言われた事はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever been criticized for acting on your own instincts?

dialogue.content: ありますね何か気に入らないと、怒鳴られたりもします
dialogue.English: Yes. If they don't like something, they'll even shout at me.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。それは誰でも萎縮してしまいますね。。差し支えなければどのような場面で怒鳴られてしまったのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I see... That would make anyone feel intimidated. If you don't mind sharing, could you tell me in what kind of situations you've been shouted at?

dialogue.content: 沢山あります。掃除の仕方だったり、私の言葉の選び方だったり、子供達が遊んでいるとうるさい！など
dialogue.English: There have been many instances. The way I clean, my choice of words, or when the children are playing, they'll shout, 'It's too loud!' and things like that.

dialogue.content: 気分でそうしてるだけなんだろうな、とは思ってます
dialogue.English: I think they're just doing it based on their mood at the moment.

dialogue.content: なるほどです。。ですが、怒鳴られて気持ち良いと感じる人はいないです。。因みに旦那様はこの事を知っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. But no one feels good about being shouted at. By the way, does your husband know about this?

dialogue.content: はい、知ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, he knows.

dialogue.content: でも、親の言う事なので、特に問題とは思ってないですね
dialogue.English: But since it's his parents, he doesn't seem to think it's a problem.

dialogue.content: 私も、夫の親なので、夫も良い気がしないだろうと思って、あまり嫌な気持ちを言いません
dialogue.English: And because they're his parents, I think it would make him feel bad, so I don't often say how upset I am.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。たしかに旦那様が気にしていなかったら誰でも、とても良いづらい気持ちになりますね。。因みに義両親の両方ともどなるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's true that if your husband doesn't seem concerned, it would be very difficult for anyone to bring it up. By the way, do both of your parents-in-law shout?

dialogue.content: 良いづらい　☓言いづらい　○失礼しました。
dialogue.English: *Correction: I meant to say 'difficult to say.' My apologies.*

dialogue.content: 怒鳴るのは義父だけです。義母は義父に何も言えないタイプです
dialogue.English: Only my father-in-law shouts. My mother-in-law is the type who can't say anything to him.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。子供への影響はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there any effect on your children?

dialogue.content: 子供はもう、おじいちゃん嫌い！と言ってるだけで、あまり気にしてないです
dialogue.English: The children just say, 'I hate Grandpa!' but they don't seem too bothered by it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。。正直、家にいるのは大分お辛くないですか？
dialogue.English: I see. To be honest, isn't it quite difficult for you to be at home?

dialogue.content: 窮屈に感じますね
dialogue.English: It feels restrictive.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。両親はともかく、旦那さんが理解してくれない、察して事に対してどのように感じますか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... Leaving his parents aside, how do you feel about your husband not understanding or noticing what's going on?

dialogue.content: 本当は味方でいてくれたら良いんですけどね
dialogue.English: I really wish he would be on my side.

dialogue.content: 諦めてます
dialogue.English: But I've given up on that.

dialogue.content: それはそう感じますよね。。因みに義両親ではなく、かおりさんのご両親にも相談できそうに無いですか？
dialogue.English: I can understand why you'd feel that way. By the way, could you talk to your own parents about this, and not just your in-laws?

dialogue.content: 父は亡くなり、母とはそれほど仲良くないです。
dialogue.English: My father has passed away, and I'm not very close with my mother.

dialogue.content: 義両親とうまくいっていないというより、私の悩みは人の顔色を見てしまう事なので、母に話して何とかなるのかも疑問ですね
dialogue.English: It's less about not getting along with my parents-in-law and more that my problem is reading people's expressions. I doubt talking to my mother would solve anything.

dialogue.content: すみません。14時から別のロールプレイがあります。。ありがとうございました。途中となり申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I have another role-play session starting at 2:00 PM. Thank you very much. I apologize for cutting this short.

dialogue.content: はい！ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay! Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 素直な評価をお願い致します！
dialogue.English: Please provide your honest feedback!
